title: Sunset Boulevard Coleus - 2x Mini Plug Plants - Rare Coleus
description:
Vibrant foliage for stunning displays in sun or shade!


KEY FEATURES
• Stunning salmon pink, dark copper, and olive variegated foliage
• Sun-tolerant variety, maintaining vibrant colour in various light conditions
• Upright growth habit, ideal for containers, baskets, and bedding
• Low maintenance and fast-growing annual
• Excellent for creating colourful combinations and focal points


PLANT DETAILS
Type: Houseplants — Plectranthus scutellarioides 'Main Street Sunset Boulevard'
Colour: Salmon pink, dark copper, olive
Season: Summer to Autumn (foliage interest)
Growth Habit: Upright spreading


GROWING CONDITIONS
Sun: Sun to Partial Shade
Soil: Evenly moist, well-draining garden soil rich in organic matter (pH 6.0-7.0)
Watering: Keep soil consistently moist; avoid waterlogging or allowing to dry out completely
Spacing: 12-18 inches (30-45 cm)
Height: 10-24 inches (25-60 cm)
Spread: 12-24 inches (30-60 cm)
Hardiness: USDA Zone 10 (Tender perennial, typically grown as an annual in the UK)


CARE INSTRUCTIONS
• Plant outdoors after the last frost when night temperatures are reliably above 15°C.
• Pinch tips regularly to encourage bushier growth and prevent legginess.
• Fertilise every 2-4 weeks during the growing season with a balanced liquid feed (half-strength for in-ground plants).
• Ensure good drainage, especially in containers, to prevent root rot.
• Can be overwintered indoors on a sunny windowsill or propagated from cuttings in early autumn.


WHAT'S INCLUDED
2x Mini Plug Plants
